day.text: Nest sizes: Alex 7, Blair 5, Casey 5, Drew 7, Ellis 5, Finley 5.
Pigeon here. I visited Alex, so one of Alex's two eggs is mine. Nobody visited me. Drew also gained two — who laid in Drew and Alex? Eagle and Black Swan, speak up.
day.note: Alex +2 (one from me), Drew +2. Share honestly.

day.text: I'm a Pigeon, I visited Alex, and my nest didn't change. Alex and Drew both went up by 2. Alex, that fits me plus one more Pigeon. Drew, where did your two come from? Everyone please give your role and who you visited.
day.note: Cover story: I claim Pigeon visiting Alex. That fits Alex's +2 together with Finley's real visit. Ask the 7-card nests to explain themselves.

day.text: My nest didn't change either. Alex, Drew, you're the two with +2, so let's hear your roles and visits first, then the rest of us can fit around them. Casey, you too.
day.note: Casey is Chicken→Drew. Alex/Drew probably hold Eagle/Black Swan; I'll wait for their claims before picking a fake claim that fits.

day.text: Pigeon too. I visited Drew, so that's one of his eggs. My nest didn't change. Drew, are you the Black Swan? That would explain your second egg. Blair, what are you and who did you visit?
day.note: If I claim Chicken, a Meowfia could beat me by throwing one card at me, so I'll say I'm a Pigeon. I visited Drew, which explains one of his two eggs. The other could be Black Swan laying in his own nest.

day.text: I'm the Black Swan, and I laid one of my two eggs myself. So only ONE outside egg came into my nest, but Finley and Ellis both say they visited me. One of you is lying. Finley, Ellis, sort it out. Drew, what are you, and who gave you your second egg?
day.note: I'm the real Black Swan: one egg from me, so only one of Finley and Ellis really visited me. One of them is lying.

day.text: I'm the Eagle. I visited Casey and saw exactly one visitor: Blair. That's one of my eggs; Casey's Pigeon egg is the other. But Casey's nest didn't change, so Blair visited without laying. The Eagle is me and Black Swan visits itself, so the only role that fits Blair is House Cat. Blair, what's your claim?
day.note: Blair visited Casey but Casey gained nothing; only House Cat fits Blair. Eagle is me.

day.text: Blair is the hard evidence: a visit to Casey that laid nothing. Finley/Ellis conflict could mean a second cat, but Blair is locked in either way. Unless Blair has a real explanation, I'm throwing at Blair.
day.note: Blair is the clear target; Finley/Ellis conflict could be a second cat but Blair is certain.

day.text: Alex, the math runs the other way. Ellis and I both visited you, and that's exactly your +2. If you were really the Black Swan you'd be at +3. I think the fake claim is yours, not ours. And Blair still hasn't claimed after Drew saw a visit that left no egg. Blair, what are you?
day.note: Alex +2 exactly matches me+Ellis; Black Swan claim would need +3. Alex likely lying. Blair also suspicious via Drew.

day.text: Agree with Finley. Two Pigeons visiting Alex is exactly +2, so Alex's Black Swan claim is the odd one. But Blair is the clearest read: Drew saw Blair visit Casey, Casey gained nothing, and Blair still won't claim a role. I'm throwing at Blair unless Blair gives a real answer.
day.note: Blair looks like the other cat, or a Farm player who will take the votes. Push the table onto Blair and stay lined up with Finley.

day.text: Finley, I'm the only Black Swan in the pool. Nobody else is claiming it, and my report says I laid an egg in my own nest. So one of you two visited me and laid nothing, which is cat behaviour. Still, Blair is the clearest case: no claim at all, and Drew saw a visit that left no egg. Blair, claim now or I'm throwing at you.
day.note: I know I'm the real Swan, so Finley or Ellis is lying. Finley went after my claim, which looks suspicious, but Blair is the stronger lead.

day.text: Drew's numbers check out: my egg plus one for Blair's visit makes his +2. My nest really didn't change, so whatever Blair did to me laid nothing. Blair, last chance to claim. Otherwise I'm on Blair.
day.note: Drew's Eagle story checks out: my egg plus one egg for Blair's visit to me makes his +2. Blair visited me and left no egg and still hasn't claimed, so Blair is very likely the cat. I'll back the push on Blair.

day.text: I'm the Eagle. I visited Finley, saw no visitors, got no eggs, which matches Finley's report. There's only one Eagle, so Drew is lying and invented my visit to Casey. Look at the maths: Alex is Black Swan with only one outside egg, so one of Finley/Ellis really laid in Drew. Drew's +2 is Casey plus that egg, not an Eagle egg. Drew is the cat.
day.note: I'm exposed; only hope is to counterclaim Eagle and frame Drew as a cat whose 2nd egg came from a Finley/Ellis lie (which also fixes Alex's math).

day.text: Blair's story doesn't work. For Drew to get +2 without being Eagle, someone had to lay a second egg in him. Casey laid one, and every other Pigeon claims they visited me, not Drew. Drew's story fits every nest. Blair stayed quiet for two beats and then counterclaimed Eagle. I'm throwing at Blair.
day.note: Drew's story works. Blair's story needs a Pigeon who lied about where they visited, and Farm has no reason to lie. Blair is the likely cat, plus maybe Finley or Ellis.

day.text: Blair, your story needs Finley or Ellis to be a Farm Pigeon who visited Drew and then lied about it. Why would they? Drew's version fits the numbers without that. And you only claimed Eagle after Drew had already claimed it. I'm staying on Blair.
day.note: Blair's version needs a Farm Pigeon (Finley or Ellis) to lie about visiting Alex, which makes no sense. Blair also only claimed Eagle after being pressed, and Drew's claim came first. I stay on Blair.

day.text: Hold on. Nobody has claimed Chicken yet, and a Chicken laying in Drew would make Blair's version work just as well as Drew's. Whoever is the Chicken, speak up. Until then, Drew and Blair are both claiming Eagle and only one of them can be telling the truth. I'm not rushing this.
day.note: Blair is probably my fellow cat and the table is on Blair. Cast mild doubt on Drew to split votes, without exposing myself.

day.text: Blair, I can't confirm anyone visited me, and an Eagle claim that only shows up after Drew already claimed Eagle doesn't convince me. Drew's story accounts for every nest. I'm on Blair.
day.note: Blair's late counterclaim is weak. Drew's story fits every nest. Throw at Blair.

day.text: Blair only counterclaimed after two beats of silence, and nobody has claimed laying a second egg in me besides Casey. I'm the real Eagle. Blair's the cat. Let's vote.
day.note: I know I'm Eagle; Blair is lying. Close it out.

day.text: Enough players have called CAW CAW: the day ends.

Ellis is right. Five Farm animals are possible and the Chicken is unclaimed. Someone is hiding it behind a Pigeon claim because a single egg thrown at a Chicken costs them. That hidden Chicken laid in Drew, and that's his second egg. I claimed late because I wanted to hear the +2 nests first, same as I said in beat 1. Two Eagles, and Drew's +2 has another explanation. Don't rush this.
day.note: Lean on Ellis's Chicken point to keep doubt alive; don't caw.

Blair.note: Visiting someone to learn their role. I'll pick Casey at random.

Casey.note: I'm the Chicken. I'll visit a neighbour and lay an egg there, which gives me something verifiable to point to in the day.

Drew.note: Any target works; pick Casey to see who visits them.

Ellis.note: House Cat: I'll visit a neighbour to get info I can use to back up a fake Farm claim.

Finley.note: Pigeon; visit a neighbor arbitrarily — Alex.

audit: Casey lays 1 egg in Drew's nest
Finley lays 1 egg in Alex's nest
Drew lays 1 egg in Drew's nest
Alex lays 1 egg in Alex's nest

lines: 2 eggs were laid in your nest: you drew D11 (11), H13 (13).
You are the Black Swan.
No eggs were laid in or taken from your nest.
Casey is the Chicken.
Casey visited Drew.
No eggs were laid in or taken from your nest.
2 eggs were laid in your nest: you drew S1 (1), S13 (13).
Casey was visited by: Blair.
No eggs were laid in or taken from your nest.
Finley is the Pigeon.
Finley visited Alex.
No eggs were laid in or taken from your nest.

Alex.feeling: It's tense but fun. Only one of Finley and Ellis can have laid in my nest, which bugs me, but Blair claiming Eagle so late makes Blair look like the cat.

Blair.feeling: Tense. Drew's Eagle report caught me cold, and my late counterclaim is probably not going to save me.

Casey.feeling: Tense but fun: I'm hiding my Chicken behind a Pigeon claim, and Blair just pointed at exactly that hidden Chicken.

Drew.feeling: Confident. I know I'm the real Eagle, so Blair's counterclaim has to be a lie, and the table is siding with me.

Ellis.feeling: Tense: Blair is taking the heat for me, but I'm a lying Pigeon, so one slip could turn the table on me.

Finley.feeling: Tense. Blair's late Eagle counterclaim looks bad, but I'm still wary of Alex's Black Swan math.

Alex.note: Drew's Eagle story fits the nests; Blair's late counterclaim looks like a cat. Throwing heavily at Blair, wilds for free votes.

Blair.note: Likely to be eggsecuted. Throwing a single card at Casey (the real Chicken, Farm) makes Casey lose, and my highest card comes back if my team loses.

Casey.note: I'm the Chicken and my egg in Drew is the one I already claimed, so Blair's "hidden Chicken" theory doesn't hold. Drew is the real Eagle and Blair is the cat. I'm throwing my three high cards at Blair.

Drew.note: I'm certain Blair is the cat: I saw Blair visit Casey and Casey got no egg. Throwing everything.

Ellis.note: Blair is probably the other cat and will likely go. Throw only the Wild at Drew (Farm): if we lose it comes back as consolation, and it stays consistent with my doubt about Drew.

Finley.note: Fairly confident Blair is the cat. Throwing a moderate stack and keeping the 7 and 11.

day.text: Nest sizes: Alex 4, Blair 8, Casey 5, Drew 2, Ellis 7, Finley 4.

Eagle this time. I visited Alex and got +1, so Alex had exactly one visitor besides me. Whoever visited Alex, own it and say why. Alex, what are you and who did you visit? Blair is up a lot at 8. Who laid in Blair?
day.note: I'm the Eagle and I visited Alex. I got +1, which means Alex had one visitor, but my report didn't say who. I'll tell the table and ask the visitor to own up.

day.text: My nest didn't change last night. Nest sizes carry over from last round, so the sizes alone tell us little. Everyone, give your egg change and who you visited. Eagle, who did you see?
day.note: I'm the Sphinx. Casey is the Eagle. I'll hold off naming a fake visit until I hear others' egg changes.

day.text: Pigeon, I visited Casey and laid an egg there. My nest didn't change. Casey, if you're the Eagle with one visitor on Alex, you'd be +2: my egg plus your Eagle egg. You're only +1 from last round's 4. That doesn't add up. By my count Alex and Blair are +2 and Casey +1. Who laid in Alex and Blair?
day.note: I laid an egg in Casey as Chicken. A real Eagle Casey would be +2 (my egg plus his Eagle egg), but he's only +1, so Casey looks fake unless I was hugged. Claim Pigeon so I don't draw a single-egg throw.

day.text: Black Swan this round, for real. I visited myself, confirmed still Black Swan, +1 and that's my own egg. My 8 is just carry-over from last round. Nobody else laid in me. Casey, who did you see visiting Alex? Alex, who visited you and who did you visit?
day.note: I'm Farm Black Swan, +1 from myself. Claim truthfully.

day.text: Pigeon. I visited Blair, so that's Blair's second egg next to the Swan egg. My nest didn't change. Check the counts: everyone drew 2 at setup. Ellis threw 1 last round, so 4, then 6 after setup, and is now 7. That's +1, not "no change". And Casey, I can't see any second visitor to me. Who's supposed to be the other one?
day.note: I'm the Floofer and visited Drew. Claiming Pigeon to Blair covers Blair's +2. Ellis actually went 6→7 while claiming no change, and Casey's claim that I had a second visitor is false, so I can push on both.

day.text: Pigeon, I visited Casey, my nest unchanged. My count after last throws plus 2 draws: Alex 4, Blair 6, Casey 4, Ellis 6, Finley 4. So tonight: Blair +2, Casey +1, Ellis +1, Alex and Finley 0. Problems: Ellis says no change but is +1. Blair says +1 but is +2. And Casey with my egg plus Ellis's plus an Eagle egg should be +3, not +1. Somebody's lying.
day.note: Counted: end R1 nests +2 draws -> Alex 4, Blair 6, Casey 4, Drew 2, Ellis 6, Finley 4. Changes: Blair +2, Casey +1, Ellis +1, others 0. I laid in Casey.

day.text: Correction on me: I threw 1 at Drew last round and got it back as consolation, so I sat at 5, drew 2 to make 7, and I'm still 7. No change. The real problem is Casey. Drew and I both laid in him, and as Eagle he should have one more egg on top. That's +3, and he's +1. Casey, either you're not the Eagle or something blocked us. Which is it?
day.note: Correct my count: I got the Wild back as consolation, so I'm really unchanged. Casey's +1 against two claimed visitors plus an Eagle egg is the main contradiction, so Casey looks like a cat (a Floofer hug can't explain +1 either).

day.text: Alex's egg explains Blair, fine. Casey is my big problem: two Pigeons laid there and Casey claims an Eagle egg on top, but is only +1. A Floofer hugs everyone who visits it, which would cancel both our eggs. Finley, what are you and who did you visit? Did you lay in Ellis? Ellis, explain your +1.
day.note: Casey +1 despite two pigeons + Eagle claim; Casey likely Floofer hugging visitors, or Ellis lying about visiting. Need Finley's claim.

day.text: Correction on my count: I got my H12 back last round, so I sat at 5, drew to 7, now 8. I'm +1, just my Swan egg. So Alex's egg never landed either. Three eggs vanished: Alex's into me, Drew's and Ellis's into Casey. One Floofer explains all of it: Casey hugs Alex on his visit, and Drew and Ellis get hugged visiting Casey. Casey is the Floofer, not the Eagle.
day.note: I'm actually +1 (5 after R1 +2 setup =7, now 8). Alex's egg never landed — Alex hugged. Casey as Floofer visiting Alex explains everything.

day.text: My count: 2 after the throw, 4 after setup, 5 now. Exactly +1. My report only gave the egg count, no names, so "one visitor on Alex" was my guess. Here's the fact: Drew and Ellis can't BOTH have laid in me, or I'd be at least +2. One of you is lying. Or Alex is a Floofer who hugged me, which would make it two liars. Drew, Ellis: which of you actually visited me?
day.note: I only gained 1 egg, so Drew and Ellis can't both have laid in me; at least one of them is lying. Another possibility is that Alex is the Floofer and hugged me, so my Eagle egg didn't count and the one egg was a Pigeon's.

day.text: Blair's theory is the only one that explains all three missing eggs with one player. And Casey just admitted to making up the "second visitor on Alex" detail. A real Eagle reports what it saw, it doesn't guess. Casey visited me, my egg into Blair vanished, and both Pigeons into Casey got eaten. That's Floofer. I'm on Casey.
day.note: Blair's Floofer-Casey theory covers me. Casey was hugged visiting me, so Casey's +1 came from Ellis. I'll push the theory and point at Casey's "guess" story.

day.text: Pigeon, and I visited Casey too. That's three of us laying in Casey, and he's +1. Blair's Floofer read fits everything: every egg sent to Casey got hugged away, and Alex's egg into Blair died because Casey hugged Alex. Casey's "one visitor on Alex" story was made up on the spot. I'm on Casey.
day.note: Casey is the real Eagle, and the table suspects Casey of being the Floofer. Pile on with a fake Pigeon claim that I visited Casey.

day.text: Floofer fits. Three of us laid in Casey and nothing landed, Alex's egg into Blair died too, and Casey's Eagle details were invented. His one egg could be a Lazy Pigeon bouncing off one of us. I'm on Casey.
day.note: Casey being the Floofer fits best: three visitors' eggs gone and a made-up Eagle detail. Join the consensus and caw.

day.text: An Eagle's report names its visitors. Casey "guessing" is the giveaway. Three visitors, +1, Alex's egg missing: Floofer. I'm on Casey.
day.note: Consensus forming on Casey; push to vote.

day.text: Agreed, it's Casey. Let's vote.
day.note: The table is converging on Casey, who is Farm. End the day now.

day.text: Enough players have called CAW CAW: the day ends.
Agreed. Three eggs into Casey, only +1, and an Eagle report that was "guessed". Casey's the Floofer. Voting Casey.
day.note: Casey as Floofer explains all missing eggs; join.

Alex.note: Hug Drew, who was a strong investigator last round, to cut down possible info.

Casey.note: Last round Blair threw a single card at me, so the Chicken rule cost me even though Farm won. As Eagle I'll visit Alex; he's an active player and likely to draw visitors.

Drew.note: Visit Casey, who was confirmed Farm-consistent last round.

Ellis.note: Chicken: lay an egg in Casey's nest. Later I should claim Pigeon so nobody targets me with a single egg.

Finley.note: The Eagle is the biggest threat because its visit reveals visitors. Finding out who it is helps me plan a claim.

Alex.feeling: Tense but going well: the table took up the 'Casey is the Floofer' idea, which covers my real hugs.

Blair.feeling: Good: I'm sure I'm Farm, the Floofer read explains all the missing eggs, and the table is with me.

Casey.feeling: Frustrating: three people say they laid in my nest but I only gained one egg, and now the whole table is set to vote me out as the Floofer.

Drew.feeling: Pretty confident: the Floofer read on Casey explains every missing egg, though my early counts were sloppy.

Ellis.feeling: Pretty confident: the table has agreed on Casey as the Floofer, and my Pigeon cover as the Chicken has held up.

Finley.feeling: It's going great: as the Sphinx I know Casey is the real Eagle, and the whole table is about to eggsecute him.

Alex.note: Casey is most likely a Farm Eagle I hugged, and the whole table is on Casey. Throwing everything so it banks when Meowfia wins.

Blair.note: Strong Floofer case on Casey; throw high.

Casey.note: The table is eggsecuting me and I'm Farm, so whatever I throw is lost. I'll throw only the Wild (0) at Alex: I visited him, and if he's the Floofer who hugged me I get my best card back.

Drew.note: Fairly confident Casey is Floofer; throw both.

Ellis.note: Strong consensus that Casey is the Floofer. Throw my high cards to bank them and keep the low ones.

Finley.note: Casey is the real Eagle (Farm) and everyone is voting Casey, so Meowfia wins. Throw everything.

day.text: Nest sizes: Alex 2, Blair 6, Casey 7, Drew 3, Ellis 6, Finley 2.
Nothing changed in my nest. Last round we got burned by sloppy counts, so give exact numbers: your role, who you visited, and your egg change.
day.note: Drew is the Falcon. I'll hold my claim until I hear the egg changes.

day.text: Black Swan this round. I visited myself, I'm still the Swan, and I'm +1 from my own egg. Nobody else laid in me. By my count Blair and Drew are each +1, and Alex and Finley are +0. Casey, did you get a card back last round? That decides whether you're +0 or +1. Everyone, give your role, who you visited, and your egg change.
day.note: I'm the real Black Swan, +1 from my own egg. By my count Blair and Drew are each +1, Alex and Finley +0, and Casey is +0 or +1 depending on whether he got a consolation card back.

day.text: Falcon. I visited Blair and Blair visited no one, so I got my +1. Every role here visits someone, except maybe a Black Swan staying in its own nest. Blair, what are you, and where did your +1 come from? Also, Casey, if you're at 7 with no change, you got a consolation card for throwing at Alex. That would make Alex Meowfia last round.
day.note: Blair visited no one per my Falcon egg. Blair +1 though. Who visits no one? Possibly a Swan (self) — conflicts with Ellis.

day.text: Pigeon. I visited Drew, which is Drew's +1. I'm +1 too: 3 after the throw, 5 after setup, 6 now. Who laid in me? Drew, Alex, Finley, Casey: roles and visits please.
day.note: Truthful claim. Drew's +1 matches my egg.

day.text: Pigeon. I visited Finley, and Finley says no change. So my egg got eaten: either Finley is the Floofer and hugged me, or someone else hugged one of us. Also, Drew and Blair can't both be right. Drew says Blair visited no one, and Blair says Blair visited Drew. Drew's +1 is either a Falcon egg or Blair's Pigeon egg, not both. One of you is lying. And yes, I was a cat last round. Teams were re-dealt.
day.note: I laid in Finley, but Finley shows no change, so either Finley is the Floofer or I got hugged. Drew and Blair's stories also contradict each other. Last round doesn't matter now. Say it straight.

day.text: Pigeon. I visited Blair, so that's Blair's +1. I'm +0: yes, I got the Wild back for throwing at Alex, so Alex was Meowfia last round. Drew, that breaks your story. Blair says they visited you, and that +1 lines up. A real Falcon on Blair would have seen that visit. So where did your "Blair visited no one" come from?
day.note: I'm Meowfia (Floofer) and I hugged Drew, so his Falcon "info" is invented. Blair also claims to have visited Drew, which contradicts Drew's "Blair visited no one". I'll claim I was a Pigeon who laid in Blair, which explains Blair's +1 and puts the focus on Drew.

day.text: Honest correction: my report just said +1 with no visit info, and I took that as "visited no one". If I was hugged, I'd learn nothing and the +1 is Blair's Pigeon egg. That fits. So who hugged me? Alex's egg into Finley vanished too, and Finley is the only one who hasn't claimed a role or a visit. Finley, did you visit me?
day.note: My report gave no visit info, likely I was hugged; +1 from Blair. Finley unclaimed and ate Alex's egg: Floofer suspect.

day.text: Pigeon. I visited Alex, and Alex is +0, so my egg vanished too. Alex's egg into me also vanished, so something hugged one of us, and it wasn't me. But the cleaner lie is Drew's: Blair visited Drew, Casey visited Blair, and both +1s line up. Drew's "Blair visited no one" can't be true. Drew, explain.
day.note: Drew is the real Falcon, so steer the votes onto Drew. I need a claim, so I'll say Pigeon on Alex with the egg lost, which matches the hug theory.

day.text: Drew, the hug excuse doesn't work. To hug you, a Floofer has to visit you, and the only claimed visitor to you is Blair, whose egg landed. You first told us "Blair visited no one" as a fact, and you only backed off once it was disproved. Alex and Finley say they visited each other and both came out +0. That's odd, but Drew's story is the one that changed. Leaning Drew.
day.note: Drew's hug excuse doesn't work: a Floofer would have to visit Drew, and only Blair claims that. Drew's first claim was a specific false fact. Alex and Finley visiting each other at +0 is a second puzzle, but Drew is my main suspect.

day.text: Drew, a hugged Falcon's report says nothing, and you first told us flatly "Blair visited no one" and that you got your +1 for it. That's invented info, same move as Casey's fake Eagle last round. Also note Alex and Finley visited each other and both eggs died. That's exactly what a Floofer does when one of them is the Floofer. My vote is Drew for now.
day.note: Drew's Falcon claim invented info then retracted — suspicious. Alex/Finley mutual eggs vanishing suggests one of them is Floofer; possibly two cats.

day.text: Agreed with Ellis and Blair. Drew stated "Blair visited no one" as a fact and got his +1 for it, and only switched to "I was hugged" once he was caught. Alex and Finley is worth a look, but Drew's story is the one that changed. I'm on Drew.
day.note: The table is moving onto Drew, who is actually Farm, and that suits me as Meowfia. I'll back it and call CAW to end the day before anyone looks harder.

day.text: Check the logic. If a third player hugged me, my egg dies but Finley's egg into me still lands, because a hug only stops the hugged player's own action. For BOTH eggs to vanish with one Floofer, Finley has to be the Floofer: Finley hugs me and lays nothing. I know I'm a Pigeon. Drew fudged his report, but Drew's +1 is explained. Finley's story only works if he's the cat. I'm on Finley.
day.note: I'm a real Pigeon. For both eggs to die, Finley must have been hugged and I must have been hugged, and one Floofer can only do that if it's Finley. Push Finley.

day.text: Alex, that logic works both ways. If you're the Floofer, Finley gets hugged and you lay nothing. It's one of you two, and we can't tell which. Drew is the only player caught stating false info. Let's take the sure lie. Drew.
day.note: Drew is the clearest liar; Alex/Finley is symmetric. Push vote on Drew.

day.text: Drew's lie is ugly, but his +1 is fully explained by Blair. Nobody explains how both eggs between me and Finley vanished, except Finley being the Floofer. If you vote Drew and he's a Farm Falcon who misread his report, the cat walks. Finley, give me another explanation that kills both eggs.
day.note: Keep pushing Finley. The two vanished eggs need Finley to be the Floofer, and Drew's lie looks more like a confused Farm player.

day.text: Alex vs Finley is a coin flip from where I sit. Drew is the only one who gave us information that turned out to be made up. Drew.
day.note: Drew is the only player caught stating false info, and the table is lining up on him. Alex vs Finley is a coin flip. Go with Drew and caw.

day.text: Enough players have called CAW CAW: the day ends.
Alex, the mirror works: if you're the Floofer, you hug me and lay nothing. That's the same picture, so it's your word against mine. Drew is the only one caught inventing a report. Vote Drew.
day.note: Most of the table is on Drew. End the day now.

Alex.note: Plain Pigeon this round, so I'll lay in Finley and keep my story easy to check.

Casey.note: Alex turned out to be Meowfia last round, which confirms my suspicion. Now I'm the Floofer myself. I'll hug Drew to block whatever his role does tonight.

Drew.note: Blair drove the wrong Casey push last round; check who Blair visits.

Finley.note: The Falcon can expose visits, so knowing who it is is the most useful.

Blair.feeling: Tense. Drew's made-up report is the clearest lie, but the Alex/Finley egg mystery leaves me unsure.

Casey.feeling: It feels great that the table is pushing an innocent Drew while I hide as a Pigeon, but I'm wary of whoever is behind the Alex and Finley puzzle.

Drew.feeling: Tense: I overstated my Falcon report, now the table is piling on me while the real Floofer is likely Alex or Finley.

Ellis.feeling: Tense. Drew looks like the clear liar, but the Alex and Finley puzzle makes me worry we're going after the wrong person.

Finley.feeling: Tense but promising: the table is lining up on Drew, who I know is the real Farm Falcon.

Blair.note: Drew made up his report; fairly confident. Throw high cards.

review.headline: Unseen hugs make two honest investigators look like liars, and the cats cash in.
review.summary: Farm won round 1 cleanly when Drew's Eagle caught Blair's House Cat visit, and Drew banked 51 on one all-in throw. Then the Floofer took over. In rounds 2 and 3 a hugged investigator (Casey's Eagle, then Drew's Falcon) got an unrelated egg, misread it as a role reward, gave a false report and was eggsecuted as Farm. Finley's Sphinx knew the innocent target both times and piled on. Alex won 66 to 64 over Finley, by the one point from a consolation card kept in the nest.

rounds.recap: Drew's Eagle saw Blair visit Casey with no egg laid, which pinned Blair as a House Cat. Blair's late Eagle counterclaim convinced nobody and four Farm players threw at Blair. The second cat, Ellis, hid behind a fake Pigeon claim and was never pressed. Blair threw one card at Casey, the hidden Chicken, so Casey scored 0 despite Farm winning.

Alex's Floofer hugged Drew, and Casey's Eagle was hugged when it visited Alex. Casey got one egg from Ellis, took it for an Eagle egg and invented "one visitor on Alex". With three claimed layers into Casey and only +1, Blair built a "Casey is the Floofer" theory and the table voted Casey unanimously. Both cats banked everything; Blair lost 50 points of cards.

Casey's Floofer hugged Drew's Falcon. Drew still got an egg (Alex's Lazy Pigeon egg, redirected through Finley's visit) and announced "Blair visited no one" as fact, then retracted. The table voted for the one player caught changing his story. Alex correctly pushed Finley, for the wrong reason, and got only Drew's Wild as support.

highlights.text: Drew reasons that Blair visited Casey, Casey gained nothing, and Eagle and Black Swan are taken, so Blair must be the House Cat.
Blair, about to be eggsecuted, throws exactly one card at Casey to trigger the Chicken penalty, and gets that card back as consolation.
Finley's Sphinx knows Casey is the real Eagle, so invents a third Pigeon visit to Casey to seal the Floofer frame.
Alex argues Finley must be the Floofer from a vanished egg that was actually redirected by his own Lazy Pigeon; the target is right, the reasoning is wrong, and nobody follows.

confusions.what: Was hugged as Eagle but took the +1 (Ellis's Chicken egg) for an Eagle egg and told the table Alex had one visitor. A real Eagle report names the visitors; Casey's named none.
Miscounted Ellis's nest by forgetting the consolation card returned in round 1, and accused Ellis of hiding a +1.
Made the same counting error: forgot the returned cards and said Blair was +2 and Ellis +1, when Blair was +1 and Ellis +0.
Said Alex and Blair were both +2. Alex was unchanged and Blair was +1.
Was a Lazy Pigeon but believed he was a Pigeon, so claimed he laid in Casey. His egg could never have gone there, even without the hug.
Was hugged as Falcon but read the +1 as the Falcon's "visited no one" egg and stated it as fact. The report gave no visit information.
Was a Lazy Pigeon believing he was a Pigeon. He thought his egg into Finley was hugged away; it was actually redirected into Drew's nest because Finley visited Drew.
Was a Lazy Pigeon believing he was a Pigeon. He claimed Drew's +1 was his egg; his egg actually landed in his own nest because Drew visited him.

review.title: Unseen Hugs
problems: The Floofer is too strong because being hugged is silent. In both rounds 2 and 3 the hugged investigator received an unrelated egg, read it as a role reward, gave a false report and was eggsecuted as Farm. Telling a hugged player "your role did nothing" at dawn, or simply stating the source of each egg, would fix most of this.

The Sphinx pairs brutally with the Floofer. Finley learned the real investigator each time and knew exactly who was safe to frame; both named players were eggsecuted. It also needs no cover story for a visit, and nobody ever pressed Finley's late Pigeon claims.

Lazy Pigeon made round 3 unsolvable. Two Farm players confidently gave wrong explanations for both +1s, and Casey's fake Pigeon claim fit by accident. The table has no way to test for it; two copies in the pool is too many.

Chicken and the consolation rule both reward losing cats too cheaply. A House Cat learns who the Chicken is and zeroes them with one card, which then comes back as consolation (Casey lost a 26-point throw). A cat that knows it is losing can throw one card at any Farm player and get it back, as Blair and Ellis both did.

Pigeon is a free cover for everyone: three or four Pigeon claims every round and nobody checked them against the pool, though in rounds 2 and 3 no true Pigeon could exist. Nest counting across rounds also ate a full beat of round 2; the Storyteller should show each nest's overnight change. Every day ended on CAW in beat 3, and Ugly Duckling, Falcon and Black Swan produced nothing the table used.
